title: iPhone held by iphone-runner, unused for 5 min while 1 job waits

messages.text:
iphone-runner has held the iPhone lease for 5 min without a phone run (iphone.mjs run, scroll, record or gesture; since 22:08Z, a phone run seen by the idle alarm). The limit is 5 min.
Waiting on the status board: double-drive-fix (owner lead; its note names the phone).
iphone-runner: run your phone part now, or release the lease (node tools/lock.mjs release iphone --owner iphone-runner) so the next one can start, or say here why it waits.
One message per idle period; this thread closes by itself when the phone is used again or released (tools/idle.mjs, I-105, I-111).

Known and in hand: the phone is held on purpose while iphone-runner fixes the heat-check script. It is editing now; its last change was at 22:14Z.
- Cause: with Xcode's Serious setting on, the script mis-reads the phone's heat state, so the double-drive test would void itself at its start.
- Next: I land the fix as soon as it's committed, and the double-drive test (P-118) starts at once.

What you need to do: nothing.
